source.note: Verbatim. Region tags added by hand; nothing else changed.

situation: The worst single question in this repo's recorded history: 266 words of question text and option descriptions, weighing three ways to grant a command board access. Behind a sixteen-word lead-in.
why_this_ask: The repaired ceiling needs a real instance that fails it. Six of 134 recorded questions exceed 200 words; this is the worst, and it fails by 33% — closable by trimming descriptions, which is exactly the remedy the standard prescribes.
co_occurring: All four modes fire. This ask predates the standard entirely.
